mike_support: Heads-up — Acme Corp (acct ACME-77) did a mid-cycle plan change on 2025-03-02 (Team -> Enterprise). Payment flow got messy: initial card attempt declined, then customer paid by PO (PO# PO-8842) but our system shows a partial credit note that included VAT twice. Can billing take a look? invoice INV-2025-03-1502, credit note draft CN-2025-03-047.

emily_billing_ops: Thanks, pinging @sara_fin and @raj_accounts_payable. Do we have the exact amounts and the proration days? Also need to know whether PO flagged VAT-exempt / reverse-charge.

mike_support: Quick numbers from the order: original monthly fee $1,200 -> new rate $3,000. Change happened on 2025-03-02, billing period 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31 (31 days). Card attempted on 2025-03-02 (card declined), customer submitted PO and AP paid on 2025-03-05. System created CN for $1,935.48 but ledger shows VAT added twice (should be single VAT or reverse-charge).

sara_fin: PO has VAT reverse-charge note in the header (EU client). PO-8842 explicitly says "reverse charge — VAT to be accounted by buyer". So credit should be VAT-exempt. Looks like the credit creation picked up default VAT profile.

emily_billing_ops: Ok — likely a tax-profile mapping bug where PO payments aren't marking the invoice as reverse-charge. Can you attach the PO scan, @mike_support? Need screenshot of how it was entered in the payments UI.

mike_support: attached (scan and payment receipt). Also copied the invoice lines from the system export: 
```
INV-2025-03-1502 lines:
- Subscription (Team -> Enterprise mid-cycle) qty 1 net 2689.52
- VAT 20% 537.90
Total 3227.42
Credit CN-2025-03-047 generated net 1612.90 VAT 322.58 total 1935.48
```
Note: credit net looks like proration algorithm output; VAT on credit should be 0 due to PO reverse-charge.

raj_accounts_payable: For the accounting treatment: if payment came via PO and PO indicates reverse-charge, we need the credit note to be tax_exempt and we have to post the offset to AR without changing VAT accruals. If CN has VAT, it creates a VAT liability misstatement. We should void current CN draft and reissue tax_exempt.

emily_billing_ops: Agreed. Two steps: 1) void draft CN-2025-03-047, 2) create CN-2025-03-047-R with tax_exempt flag, same net amount, memo referencing PO-8842 and finance approval. Who can run the create? I can, but need access to the original calculated net to avoid rounding issues. Mike provided net 1612.90 — confirm math: proration calc below.

mike_support: Here's the proration calc I used (customer-facing):
```
Billing period days: 31
Days on old plan: 1 (Mar 1)
Days on new plan: 30 (Mar 2-31)
Charge already billed (Team): 1/31 * $1,200 = $38.71
Charge owed for Enterprise: 30/31 * $3,000 = $2903.23
Prorated charge difference = $2903.23 - $38.71 = $2864.52
But customer had a partial charge/refund flow — system pro-rated differently (applied credit for unused Team portion). Net on invoice export differs due to internal rounding and coupon credits, which yields net 2689.52 above.
```

emily_billing_ops: Thanks. I'll void the draft and create a tax_exempt credit note for net 1612.90 (or system net 2689.52? we need to reconcile). @sara_fin can you confirm which net to use — system shows 2689.52 on invoice lines but the CN net shows 1612.90 (looks like partial refund only). Which one reflects the correct business decision?

sara_fin: Business approved only a partial credit (customer asked for downgrade refund for unused new plan days between attempted card and PO payment). So CN should match the customer's agreed partial amount 1612.90 (not the full proration). We just need VAT=0. Finance will reclass the VAT lines.

billing-bot: CN-2025-03-047 status: draft (created by automated proration job). Reaction: :warning: automated-tax-profile: EU_EUROPE_DEFAULT applied.

emily_billing_ops: Action plan: I'll void CN-2025-03-047 (reason: tax mismatch + PO reverse-charge), create credit note CN-2025-03-047A with net 1612.90, tax_exempt=true, memo "Partial credit for mid-cycle plan change — PO-8842 — finance approved" and then mark CN as issued. I'll also add ledger note to reverse the VAT entry created by the draft. Posting steps I'm about to run: 
```
# void draft CN
POST /internal/billing/credit_notes/CN-2025-03-047/void  { reason: "tax/mapping error - voiding draft" }

# create corrected CN
POST /internal/billing/credit_notes  {
  invoice_id: "INV-2025-03-1502",
  net_amount: 1612.90,
  currency: "USD",
  tax_exempt: true,
  memo: "Partial credit — PO-8842, finance approved"
}
```
I'll DM @raj_accounts_payable when done and request they confirm ledger entries.

raj_accounts_payable: After you create CN-2025-03-047A, we'll run a VAT reversal journal: 
```
Journal: Reverse VAT on CN-2025-03-047 (amount 322.58)
DR VAT Payable 322.58
CR Revenue/VAT Adjustment 322.58
```
Then we'll reconcile AR to reflect the PO payment net.

mike_support: Thanks — please also update the support ticket S-38291 with the resolution steps and copy the corrected CN and final invoice. Customer wants confirmation message to AP contact once credit applied.

emily_billing_ops: Will do. ETA: void + create + ledger note within 2 hours. I will post the CN number and attach PDF when issued.

billing-bot: CN-2025-03-047 -> voided by emily_billing_ops (ts 1937654310). New credit note CN-2025-03-047A created (status: issued) by emily_billing_ops (ts 1937654379).

sara_fin: Verified ledger adjustment queued. Will confirm once posted.

emily_billing_ops: Done — CN-2025-03-047A issued, tax_exempt=true, memo includes PO-8842. Attached PDF and ledger reference GL-AP-2025-03-224. Notifying customer AP. :white_check_mark:

mike_support: Great — closing ticket once customer confirms receipt. Thanks team!
